objective: train a domain-robust coarse subcellular-localization image encoder on HPA plus the already-consumed OpenCell provider, then evaluate exactly once on an untouched Allen Cell Collection provider without requiring an Aleph sweep
objective_rationale: Aleph parameter sweeps are not yet computationally executable at the required scale; the independent observation encoder is useful now, while its outputs remain non-authoritative context for a future forward-sensitivity-calibrated sweep

OpenCell.image_type: live-cell endogenous fluorescent protein confocal projection
OpenCell.annotation_state: already consumed by the refused v1 external-holdout attempt; never pristine again

AllenCell.provider: Allen Institute for Cell Science Cell Feature Explorer hiPSC single-cell image dataset
AllenCell.image_type: live-cell endogenous fluorescent protein 3D single-cell image

mapping_contract.normalization: Unicode casefold, trim surrounding whitespace, replace runs of hyphen or whitespace with one underscore; first use normalized whole-label equality, and only when no equality exists use casefolded substring tokens
mapping_contract.mixed_mapped_and_unmapped_author_labels: exclude from supervised development and report
mapping_contract.all_unmapped_author_labels: semantic_OOD development rows or confirmation OOD rows

opencell_development_contract.selection: admit every target whose grade-2-or-3 labels all map; exclude exact HPA gene overlap only from external claims, not from development training
opencell_development_contract.split_assignment: sha256(salt + '|' + target_name) modulo 20: 0-2 calibration, 3-5 selection, 6-19 train
opencell_development_contract.semantic_OOD_development_selection: admit every target whose grade-2-or-3 labels are all unmapped; OOD labels never enter the localization loss

allencell_metadata_gate.metadata_selection: from the frozen named Quilt package, select the lexicographically first CSV or Parquet member whose normalized headers uniquely resolve cell_id, tagged_structure, tagged_gene_or_protein, and image_object_path
allencell_metadata_gate.ambiguous_or_missing_required_field: refuse before any Allen image object or prediction

allencell_confirmation_sampling.unit: tagged structure cell line or clone; cells are nested technical observations
allencell_confirmation_sampling.cell_selection: ascending sha256(salt + '|' + cell_id), after metadata gate
allencell_confirmation_sampling.exact_development_gene_overlap: retain but report separately; primary endpoint requires the macro result over structures whose exact tagged gene is absent from both HPA and OpenCell development targets when at least six such structures exist
allencell_confirmation_sampling.insufficient_unseen_structure_support: refuse unseen-protein authority but still perform and report provider-transfer confirmation
allencell_confirmation_sampling.confirmation_pixels_may_be_opened: only after the exact model checkpoint, thresholds, calibration scores, and fit embedding reference are frozen

image_contract.3D_to_2D: maximum projection independently per admitted channel
image_contract.normalization: per-channel finite p1-p99 clip and scale to [0,1]; constant channel becomes all zeros and is reported

model_contract.provider_balancing: equal expected batch contribution from HPA and OpenCell, then inverse-sqrt class-frequency target weighting within provider
model_contract.loss: multilabel BCE plus supervised contrastive coarse-label loss; no Allen term
model_contract.selection: maximize the minimum normalized macro-average-precision ratio over HPA selection and OpenCell selection; ties choose earlier epoch
model_contract.calibration: per-class positive-label split conformal thresholds from disjoint HPA and OpenCell calibration targets, using the maximum provider-specific quantile
model_contract.OOD: fit-reference diagonal Mahalanobis score on the frozen 64d embedding
model_contract.device: CPU unless a separately recorded valid Slurm GPU grant exists

confirmation_endpoints.supported_class_rule: at least one Allen tagged structure and at least 10 selected cells for the class; metrics are aggregated to tagged structure before macro averaging

authority_contract.future_sweep_connection: context conditioning only after a geometry- and unit-matched Aleph observation operator plus forward-sensitivity and identifiability validation

failure_policy.OpenCell_development_gate_failure: retain metadata audit and refuse training
failure_policy.Allen_metadata_gate_failure: retain schema audit and refuse before image access
failure_policy.development_selection_failure: freeze failed checkpoint and keep Allen pixels sealed
failure_policy.confirmation_failure: consume Allen confirmation, report every failed endpoint, grant no evidence or uncertainty authority, and never tune on it
